questions.question: What is the percentage difference between the average accuracy of MMAU and MMAR across all three categories?
questions.reasoning: Step 1: Read MMAU values: 50 (Qwen2-Audio-Instruct), 65 (Audio-Reasoner), 65 (Qwen-2.5-Omni). Step 2: Compute MMAU average: (50 + 65 + 65) / 3 = 60. Step 3: Read MMAR values: 30 (Qwen2-Audio-Instruct), 25 (Audio-Reasoner), 55 (Qwen-2.5-Omni). Step 4: Compute MMAR average: (30 + 25 + 55) / 3 = 36.67. Step 5: Compute percentage difference: ((60 - 36.67) / 60) * 100 ≈ 30%.
